title: Corpus Reasoning Experiment Regeneration v1
description: Host-signed durable join between one reviewer-requested correction and the exact solver-authored successor proposal.

regeneration/ref.description: Content-addressed identity of this host-signed regeneration join.

query/id.description: Corpus query whose deliberation produced both proposals.

room/id.description: Room in which the source review and regenerated proposal were authored.

source-proposal/ref.description: Content-addressed source proposal rejected for regeneration.

source-candidate-plan/ref.description: Logical reference of the source CandidatePlan.

source-candidate-plan/artifact-ref.description: Content-addressed artifact containing the source CandidatePlan.

source-candidate-plan/digest.description: Digest of the source CandidatePlan bytes.

source-review/ref.description: Content-addressed V2 review whose verdict is request-regeneration.

correction-state/digest.description: Digest of the bounded correction capsule shared by the source review, regenerated proposal review, and this join.

solver.description: Room subject that authored the regenerated proposal.

solver/node-id.description: Node identity that signed the solver-authored proposal.

solver-turn/id.description: Exact solver turn from which the regenerated proposal originated.

regenerated-proposal/ref.description: Content-addressed successor proposal authored by the solver.

regenerated-candidate-plan/ref.description: Logical reference of the regenerated CandidatePlan.

regenerated-candidate-plan/artifact-ref.description: Content-addressed artifact containing the regenerated CandidatePlan.

regenerated-candidate-plan/digest.description: Digest of the regenerated CandidatePlan bytes.

budget.description: Host-admitted upper bounds for this regeneration attempt.

steps.description: Maximum solver steps available to regeneration.

tokens.description: Maximum aggregate model-token budget available to regeneration.

time-ms.description: Maximum wall-clock lifetime of the regeneration attempt.

class/key.description: Effective classification preserved across the regeneration chain.

host/node-id.description: Requester-host identity that admitted and signed this join.

created-at.description: Host timestamp at which the join was admitted.

expires-at.description: Earliest expiry inherited from budget, source review, and regenerated proposal.

idempotency/key.description: Requester-scoped command key used to replay the same registration safely.

signature.description: Domain-separated requester-host signature over this join.
